{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel value (-999.0) count in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check for missing values in biomarker_baseline
print("Missing values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

# Check for missing values in other columns
print("Missing values in other columns:")
print(df[['age', 'sex', 'severity', 'assay_batch']].isnull().sum())"}
